media.title: Morskie Oko sheet-music advertisement — Tygodnik Ilustrowany, 1 February 1930
media.description: Full-page advertisement for five recent dance numbers from the Morskie Oko revue, published by Gebethner i Wolff. It includes “O tem wróble świergocą,” with words by Andrzej Włast and music by Bronisław Kaper.
media.altText: Full-page Tygodnik Ilustrowany advertisement for five Morskie Oko dance numbers, including O tem wróble świergocą by Andrzej Włast and Bronisław Kaper.
media.rightsNote: Public domain: anonymous press item, 1930. Anonymous works are PD 70 years after publication (expired); also PD in the US (published through 1930).
